nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers a render request with one board's drawing
nodes.description: The read side of the semantic-board HTTP surface. It imports the Bun host's renderBoard; the CLI's render and rasterize commands reach the renderer only through this route.

nodes.name: View dispatcher
nodes.responsibility: Chooses the grammar, lays out each distinct content once, and returns the document
nodes.description: renderSemanticView picks architecture or data flow. renderArchitecture turns flow steps into lines, measures, lays out, paints and wraps, and frames the page as planned when the board has nothing built. The last 64 layouts are remembered by content and comparison standing, independent of theme, so a repeated render or a theme switch does not lay out again. Every variant is laid out fresh; nothing is carried over from a predecessor (ADR 0032).

nodes.name: Subject atlas
nodes.responsibility: Records where every drawn node, relationship and region landed
nodes.description: The geometry a reader's pointer is tested against, in viewBox units, so the picture and the inspector agree without a second measurement.

nodes.name: Compound layout
nodes.responsibility: Settles cards, frames, routes and labels as one drawing, and keeps a column fold only when it fits the pane better
nodes.description: Nothing after it may repair a coordinate. It settles one downward drawing on the host layout engine (Graphviz placement, libavoid routing; ADR 0033), placing each label on a clear run of its route and reserving space for a label no run holds. Then it solves each column count that could fit the reference pane at least WRAP_MIN_FIT_GAIN better and keeps the best complete drawing, fewer columns winning a tie. Crossings are bridged here. Every variant is laid out fresh (ADR 0032).

nodes.name: Edge geometry
nodes.responsibility: Rounds a routed polyline into a curve and says where its label may sit

nodes.name: Data-flow layout
nodes.responsibility: Places participant columns, lifelines and stacked messages for one exchange

nodes.name: Measured text
nodes.responsibility: Measures every card, note and label with the diagram faces loaded
nodes.description: Pretext prepares and wraps the runs through the host canvas, and the width of each painted line is measured there too, never estimated (TASK-247). The painted width wins over the sum of segments, so no character is cut. The sequence grammar wraps its responsibilities and step notes with the same line breaking.

nodes.name: Theme palette
nodes.responsibility: Resolves every drawn colour for the ground being drawn on

nodes.name: Architecture painter
nodes.responsibility: Paints a settled drawing as SVG marks and standing

nodes.name: SVG document
nodes.responsibility: Wraps a painted body in one self-contained document with its faces

nodes.name: Browser application
nodes.responsibility: Installs its own host in the tab and draws the same board there
nodes.description: startBrowserRenderer fills the seam with a pool of Web Workers running the same Graphviz and libavoid engine, the icons it fetched and linked faces, and loads the diagram faces into the tab so its own canvas measures in them. drawBoardHere then calls the same core the server calls (ADR 0023).

nodes.name: Bun host
nodes.responsibility: The renderer under Bun: installs the Bun host once, then calls the core
nodes.description: Every Bun entrypoint calls installBunHost (lib/bun-host.ts) first. It registers an @napi-rs/canvas canvas as the global OffscreenCanvas with the four diagram faces loaded, and installs a pool of Bun Workers that each run Graphviz placement and libavoid routing, the theme colours read from theme.css, the font bytes and the icon paths.

nodes.name: Renderer host
nodes.responsibility: The seam a host fills: the layout engine, theme colours, font bytes and icon paths
nodes.description: Why the core lives under transformers: it reads no file, no clock and no random number. One host draws the same content to the same bytes; two browsers may measure a word differently because each paints it differently.

nodes.name: Board answer
nodes.responsibility: Resolves variant, view, scope and standing from one board before anything is drawn
nodes.description: How a proposal's added, removed and changed subjects are worked out from the two variants' shared identities, per render, and never stored.

nodes.name: Sequence painter
nodes.responsibility: Paints the sequence grammar: frame, columns, messages and pulses

nodes.name: Host canvas
nodes.responsibility: The canvas of whatever draws the picture, with the diagram faces loaded
nodes.description: The global OffscreenCanvas: an @napi-rs/canvas canvas under Bun, the canvas of the tab in a browser. Pretext breaks lines through it and the renderer measures every painted line with it, so a word fits the face it is painted in (TASK-247).

beats.heading: One core, two hosts
beats.body: The renderer body reads no file, no clock and no random number. The server installs a Bun host: an @napi-rs/canvas canvas with the diagram faces, and Bun Workers running Graphviz and libavoid. The tab installs its own canvas and Web Workers running the same engines. Both then call the same board answer.

beats.heading: Words are measured before anything is placed
beats.body: Every card, note and label is measured before the layout runs, by the canvas of the place drawing the picture with the diagram faces loaded. The space a name needs is a fact the layout is given rather than one it guesses.

beats.heading: Every variant is laid out fresh, top to bottom
beats.body: The compound layout settles one downward drawing and folds it into columns only when that fits the pane materially better. Nothing is carried over from a predecessor: a proposal is laid out like any variant, and stable ids carry the comparison (ADR 0032, ADR 0033).

beats.heading: Painting and inspection share one geometry
beats.body: The painter asks the atlas where each subject landed, so the picture a reader points at and the subject the inspector opens are the same geometry, never two measurements that can disagree.

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers a render request with one board's drawing
nodes.description: The read side of the semantic-board HTTP surface. It imports the Bun host's renderBoard; the CLI's render and rasterize commands reach the renderer only through this route.

nodes.name: View dispatcher
nodes.responsibility: Chooses the grammar, lays out each distinct content once, and returns the document
nodes.description: renderSemanticView picks architecture or data flow. renderArchitecture turns flow steps into lines, measures, lays out, paints and wraps, and frames the page as planned when the board has nothing built. The last 64 layouts are remembered by content and comparison standing, independent of theme, so a repeated render or a theme switch does not lay out again. Every variant is laid out fresh; nothing is carried over from a predecessor (ADR 0032).

nodes.name: Subject atlas
nodes.responsibility: Records where every drawn node, relationship and region landed
nodes.description: The geometry a reader's pointer is tested against, in viewBox units, so the picture and the inspector agree without a second measurement.

nodes.name: Layout engines
nodes.responsibility: Settles cards, frames, routes and labels as one drawing, with the engine the render names: Track or Blocks
nodes.description: Nothing after it may repair a coordinate. Track, the default, lays the board out with its containers and group regions drawn inline; Blocks packs each as a block of its own. Both rank cards with Graphviz and route on tracks, Blocks routes the trunks between its blocks with libavoid, and each keeps the way of laying the board out that reads best. Crossings are bridged here. Every variant is laid out fresh (ADR 0032, ADR 0040).

nodes.name: Edge geometry
nodes.responsibility: Rounds a routed polyline into a curve and says where its label may sit

nodes.name: Data-flow layout
nodes.responsibility: Places participant columns, lifelines and stacked messages for one exchange

nodes.name: Measured text
nodes.responsibility: Measures every card, note and label with the diagram faces loaded
nodes.description: Pretext prepares and wraps the runs through the host canvas, and the width of each painted line is measured there too, never estimated (TASK-247). The painted width wins over the sum of segments, so no character is cut. The sequence grammar wraps its responsibilities and step notes with the same line breaking.

nodes.name: Theme palette
nodes.responsibility: Resolves every drawn colour for the ground being drawn on

nodes.name: Architecture painter
nodes.responsibility: Paints a settled drawing as SVG marks and standing
nodes.description: Paints neutral container wells, unfilled group frames, member-tagged shadows, lines and port interiors, traffic, card bodies, labels and header content in that order. Ports clip a card in its own box coordinates and traffic runs to the lid. Every card shadow lies below every line and card.

nodes.name: SVG document
nodes.responsibility: Wraps a painted body in one self-contained document with its faces
nodes.description: Wraps the painted SVG with fonts, markers, slab and port gradients, theme tokens and the near/far stylesheet. The one shared chip moves and scales; both layers of words move on a shared baseline and fade over one span with complementary opacity. Reduced motion cuts the swap.

nodes.name: Browser application
nodes.responsibility: Installs its own host in the tab and draws the same board there
nodes.description: startBrowserRenderer fills the seam with a pool of Web Workers running the same Graphviz and libavoid engine, the icons it fetched and linked faces, and loads the diagram faces into the tab so its own canvas measures in them. drawBoardHere then calls the same core the server calls (ADR 0023).

nodes.name: Bun host
nodes.responsibility: The renderer under Bun: installs the Bun host once, then calls the core
nodes.description: Every Bun entrypoint calls installBunHost (lib/bun-host.ts) first. It registers an @napi-rs/canvas canvas as the global OffscreenCanvas with the four diagram faces loaded, and installs a pool of Bun Workers that each run Graphviz placement and libavoid routing, the theme colours read from theme.css, the font bytes and the icon paths.

nodes.name: Renderer host
nodes.responsibility: The seam a host fills: the layout engine, theme colours, font bytes and icon paths
nodes.description: The host supplies layout solves, theme colors, font bytes and icon paths. A solve accepts an optional AbortSignal for queued work. An active solve still answers normally.

nodes.name: Board answer
nodes.responsibility: Resolves variant, view, scope and standing from one board before anything is drawn
nodes.description: How a proposal's added, removed and changed subjects are worked out from the two variants' shared identities, per render, and never stored.

nodes.name: Sequence painter
nodes.responsibility: Paints the sequence grammar: frame, columns, messages and pulses

nodes.name: Host canvas
nodes.responsibility: The canvas of whatever draws the picture, with the diagram faces loaded
nodes.description: The global OffscreenCanvas: an @napi-rs/canvas canvas under Bun, the canvas of the tab in a browser. Pretext breaks lines through it and the renderer measures every painted line with it, so a word fits the face it is painted in (TASK-247).

nodes.name: Slab surfaces
nodes.responsibility: Draws raised slabs and their shadows, selection seats and standing borders
nodes.description: Cards, icon chips, relationship labels and activation bars use these flat shapes. The header slab of a neutral container well uses the same slab function through tray.ts. Card and label shadows are painted in separate member-tagged groups below the lines and cards. Standing marks border the top face; no wash or hatch replaces the group tint.

nodes.name: Tray surfaces
nodes.responsibility: Draws a neutral recessed well with a group-tinted header slab
nodes.description: A container and a sequence frame use the same top-lit tray. Its floor is neutral and a nested tray is deeper. The header is a card slab, two units from the top and side walls, eight units from the outer edges. Only a placing group colors the header; kind color stays on its icon.

nodes.name: Card ports
nodes.responsibility: Cuts foot slots in cards and extends lines and traffic into their holes
nodes.description: portsOf finds lines ending at a card foot; portPlan gives the first painted line the shared well and every card its box-relative clip. portInside draws each line at its own width, and rideInto extends the pulse path to the lid. A port remains drawn in the near and far readings.

nodes.name: Near and far content
nodes.responsibility: Draws both readings of a card or header around one shared icon chip
nodes.description: paintCardViews uses sharedChip and movingWords from far-view.ts: the chip sits outside both word layers, and the words share their first baseline while moving and scaling. A container header and a sequence participant use the same card construction. paintHeadingViews draws a flow heading without a chip. document.ts supplies the swap rules.

nodes.name: Renderer core
nodes.responsibility: Turns one board and its policy into an SVG and its geometry, in any host; callers reach it only through its root files
nodes.description: src/transformers/semantic-renderer runs unchanged under Bun and in a browser. Callers outside import only its root files: board.ts for renderBoard, host.ts for installRendererHost, engine-pool.ts for the layout's workers, index.ts, engine.ts, measurement.ts and layout.ts. Everything under lib/ is private, so the parts a host reaches are its entry points and the rest are hidden parts.

nodes.name: Engine pool
nodes.responsibility: Spreads the layout's solves over a few workers, each running the layout engine
nodes.description: A solve waits until a worker is free and goes to the first that is. An optional AbortSignal cancels a solve that still waits. Active solves finish normally. A failed worker retries only work that still matters.
